item.title: The errand kids now run quick commerce in Flipkart’s Gudi Padwa ad
item.description: Festival preparations in Indian homes have long followed a familiar script: a last-minute item goes missing, a parent panics, and the youngest member of the house is sent running to the neighbourhood shop. Flipkart’s new Gudi Padwa campaign revisits this ritual, but with a modern twist. The ad opens in 1975, inside a Marathi household preparing for the festival. Amid the bustle, the wife realises something important is missing: the Marathi calendar, essential for marking the auspicious occasion.

item.title: Why Wellbeing Nutrition is putting gut comfort at the centre of protein marketing
item.description: Protein brands love talking about quality – how many grams per scoop, how fast it helps build muscle, and how it fuels performance. What they rarely talk about is what happens after we drink it. Digestive discomfort – bloating, heaviness and the awkward aftermath of protein shakes – is a familiar experience for many consumers, yet one the category has largely avoided addressing. item.title: Publicis Groupe acquires AdgeAI to expand AI-driven creative measurement
item.description: Publicis Groupe has announced the acquisition of AdgeAI, a company specialising in measurement and content intelligence. The move adds AdgeAI’s analytics capabilities to Publicis’ existing production and AI infrastructure. AdgeAI works with brands and platforms to analyse creative and video performance through engagement and conversion data. item.title: India Today Conclave 2026 to take place in New Delhi on March 13–14
item.description: The 23rd edition of the India Today Conclave will be held on March 13–14, 2026 in New Delhi. The event will take place under the theme 'Year of Breakthroughs and Breakdowns'.
